name: Combat Sorcerer
ability: Can cast Dreadful Spells in place of an attack without expending :hate:.

name: Craven
ability: When affected by the Intimidate Foe combat task, the creature also loses 1 :hate:.

name: Darker then Darkness
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to summon a supernatural darkness. Player-heroes in close combat *lose (2d)* on their first attack against the creature, while ranged attacks *lose (2d)* for the whole fight.

name: Deadly Wound
ability: Wounded targets make an *Ill-favoured* Feat die roll to determine the severity of their injury.

name: Deathless
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to cancel a Wound. When an attack inflicts damage to the creature that would cause it to go to zero Endurance, spend 1 :hate: to bring the creatures back to full Endurance instead. This ability is ineffective against Player-heroes wield-ing a magical weapon enchanted with spells for the Bane of the Undead.

name: Denizen of the Dark
ability: All attack rolls are *Favoured* while in darkness.

name: Dull-witted
ability: Player-heroes can attempt a special combat task against the creature while in Forward stance. The acting player makes a RIDDLE roll as the main action for the round: on a success, the Troll loses 1 point of :hate:, plus 1 point for each Success icon rolled.

name: Dreadful Spells
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to make one Player-hero gain :rank: Shadow points (Sorcery). Targets who fail their Shadow test or who are Miserable fall unconscious and may be roused only with a SONG roll. Otherwise, they wake up after one hour.

name: Fearless
ability: This creature’s Might is considered 1 higher for the purpose of resisting the Intimidate Foes combat task.

name: Fear of Fire
ability: The creature loses 1 :hate: at the start of each round it is engaged in close combat with an adversary wielding a torch or other burning item.

name: Fierce
ability: Spend 1 :hate: point to *gain (1d)* on an attack roll and make it *Favoured*.

name: Fierce Folk
ability: Spend 1 :hate: point to *gain (1d)* and make the attack roll *Favoured*.

name: Foul Slime
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to cause all combatants engaged with the Beithir to *lose (1d)* on all rolls for the round.

name: Great Leap
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to attack any Player-hero, in any combat stance, including Rearward.

name: Great Strength
ability: If the creature scored a Piercing Blow with a close combat attack, spend 1 :hate: to make the target’s Protection roll *Ill-favoured*.

name: Hate Sunlight
ability: The creature loses 1 :hate: for each round it is exposed to the full light of the sun.

name: Hatred (Dwarves)
ability: When fighting Dwarves, all the creature’s rolls are *Favoured*.

name: Hatred (Hobbits)
ability: When fighting Hobbits, all the creature’s rolls are *Favoured*.

name: Hatred (Rohirrim)
ability: When targeting Rohirrim, all the creature’s rolls are *Favoured*.

name: Heartless
ability: The creature is not affected by the Intimidate Foe combat task, unless a Magical success is obtained.

name: Hideous Toughness
ability: When an attack inflicts damage to the creature that would cause it to go to zero Endurance, it causes a Piercing Blow instead. Then, if the creature is still alive, it returns to full Endurance.

name: Horrible Strength
ability: If the creature scored a Piercing Blow with a close combat attack, spend 1 :hate: to make the target’s Protection roll *Ill-favoured*.

name: Howl of Triumph
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to restore 1 :hate: to all other :group: in the fight.

name: Orc-poison
ability: If an attack results in a Wound, the target is also poisoned (:rank: Endurance loss; see *The One Ring*, page 134, for the effects of poison).

name: Poison
ability: If an attack results in a Wound, the target is also poisoned (:rank: Endurance loss; see *The One Ring*, page 134, for the effects of poison).

name: Savage Assault
ability: Spend 1 :hate: after a Fangs attack to immediately roll a Claws attack on the same target.

name: Snake-like Speed
ability: When targeted by an attack, spend 1 :hate: to make the attack roll *Ill-favoured*.

name: Strike Fear
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to make all Player-heroes in sight gain :rank: Shadow points (Dread). Those who fail their Shadow test are daunted and cannot spend Hope for the rest of the fight.

name: Thick Armour
ability: Spend 1 :hate: point to *gain (2d)* on a Protection roll.

name: Thick Bark
ability: Spend 1 :hate: point to *gain (2d)* on a Protection roll.

name: Thick Hide
ability: Spend 1 :hate: point to *gain (2d)* on a Protection roll.

name: Thing of Terror
ability: At the start of the first round of the battle all Player-heroes in sight of one or more creatures with this ability gain 3 Shadow points (Dread). Those who fail their Shadow test are daunted and cannot spend Hope for the rest of the fight.

name: Wind-like Speed
ability: When targeted by an attack, spend 1 :hate: to make the attack roll *Ill-favoured*.

name: Yell of Triumph
ability: Spend 1 :hate: to restore 1 :hate: to all other :group: in the fight.
